    fiscal_year,
    fiscal_period,
    fiscal_period_label,
    calendar_year,
    calendar_month
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_year = 2026 AND calendar_month = 9
ORDER BY calendar_date
LIMIT 5

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    MIN(calendar_date) as month_start,
    MAX(calendar_date) as month_end
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_year = 2026 AND calendar_month = 9

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as record_count,
    MIN(business_date) as earliest_date,
    MAX(business_date) as latest_date,
    SUM(net_sales) as total_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2026-09-01' AND business_date <= '2026-09-30'

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT business_date) as trading_days_with_data,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_trading_day THEN calendar_date END) as total_trading_days
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
FULL OUTER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_year = 2026 AND d.calendar_month = 9

SELECT 
    SUM(f.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) as calculated_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-09-01' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-30'

SELECT 
    'Store' as channel_type,
    SUM(f.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-09-01' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-30'
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Web' as channel_type,
    SUM(f.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-09-01' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-30'
    AND f.channel_code = 'WB'

SELECT 
    'Store' as channel_type,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) as returns,
    COUNT(f.sales_line_id) as lines,
    COUNT(r.return_line_id) as return_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-09-01' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-30'
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Web' as channel_type,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) as returns,
    COUNT(f.sales_line_id) as lines,
    COUNT(r.return_line_id) as return_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-09-01' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-30'

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_lines
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2026-09-01' AND sale_date <= '2026-09-30'

WITH sales_total AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_amount) as sales_net
    FROM fact_sales_line
    WHERE sale_date >= '2026-09-01' AND sale_date <= '2026-09-30'
),
returns_total AS (
    SELECT SUM(refund_net) as returns_net
    FROM fact_return_line
    WHERE return_date >= '2026-09-01' AND return_date <= '2026-09-30'
)
SELECT 
    s.sales_net,
    COALESCE(r.returns_net, 0) as returns_net,
    s.sales_net - COALESCE(r.returns_net, 0) as net_sales
FROM sales_total s
CROSS JOIN returns_total r
